'''Olesya Vadimovna Sokur''' ({{langx|uk|Олеся Вадимівна Сокур|translit=Olesia Vadymivna Sokur}}; 25 August 1960 – 1 January 2025) was a Ukrainian biologist and biochemist and Doctor of Biological Sciences. She was killed during a Russian drone attack on her Kyiv residence during the [[Russo-Ukrainian war]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2025-01-01 |title=У Києві внаслідок дронової атаки загинуло подружжя науковців |url=https://www.ukrinform.ua/rubric-regions/3944111-u-kievi-vnaslidok-dronovoi-ataki-zaginulo-podruzza-naukovciv.html |access-date=2025-10-24 |website=www.ukrinform.ua |language=uk}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Renowned Ukrainian scientists killed in Russian drone strike on Kyiv home |url=https://english.nv.ua/life/renowned-ukrainian-scientists-killed-in-russian-drone-strike-on-kyiv-50478588.html |access-date=2025-10-24 |website=New Voice |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-01-02 |title=Russia's New Year's Day attack on Kyiv kills two prominent scientists |url=http://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2025/01/02/new-years-day-attack-on-kyiv-kills-two-prominent-scientists-education-minister-says |access-date=2025-10-24 |website=euronews |language=en}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Sokur was born on 25 August 1960 in the city of [[Uman]]. In 1982, she graduated from the Faculty of Biology of [[Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv]] with a degree in Biologist-biochemist, Teacher of biology and chemistry.

She worked at the Institute of Clinical Radiology of the Scientific Center for Radiation Medicine of the Academy of Medical Sciences of Ukraine. She met her neurobiologist husband there and also defended her PhD thesis at the Academy on [[antioxidant]] systems in regions affected by the [[Chernobyl disaster]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-01-02 |title=Присвятили життя студентам та біології: що відомо про науковців, яких убила Росія у Києві |url=https://24tv.ua/igor-zima-olesya-sokur-zaginuli-1-sichnya-biografiya-naukovtsiv_n2720650 |access-date=2025-10-24 |website=24 Канал |language=uk}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Prominent neuroscientist and biochemist: renowned scientist couple killed in Kyiv in Russian attack |url=https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/01/02/7491777/ |access-date=2025-10-24 |website=Ukrainska Pravda |language=en}}</ref>

In 2001, she was employed at Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv as a senior research associate and head of the research laboratory Physical and Chemical Research Methods<ref name=":2" /> and as a member of the Academic Council.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-01-01 |title=Prominent scientists among victims of New Year's Day drone attack in Kyiv |url=https://kyivindependent.com/prominent-scientists-among-victims-of-new-years-day-drone-attack-in-kyiv/ |access-date=2025-10-24 |website=The Kyiv Independent |language=en}}</ref>

Beginning in 2003, Sokur held administrative positions as Deputy Dean of the Faculty of Biology and Deputy Director of the National Scientific Center "[[Institute of Biology]] and Medicine" for scientific work.<ref name=":2" />

== Scientific activity ==
Sokur studied the biochemical mechanisms of cell damage in [[gastrointestinal tract]] pathologies.<ref name=":2" /> She authored "almost 200 publications, spoke at domestic and international scientific meetings (congresses of the biochemical, physiological and biophysical societies of Ukraine, international congresses on biochemistry and gastroenterology)."<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |date=2025-01-02 |title=Російський Шахед вбив науковця Ігора Зиму та його дружину – що відомо про сімʼю |url=https://tsn.ua/exclusive/rosiyskiy-shahed-vbiv-naukovciv-igorya-zimu-ta-olesyu-sokur-scho-vidomo-pro-sim-yu-foto-2736111.html |access-date=2025-10-24 |website=ТСН.ua |language=uk}}</ref>

== Death ==
On the morning of 1 January 2025, during a Russian drone attack on the capital city of Kyiv, drone fragments fell into the city center, in the Pechersk district. Some fell into the residential building on Bankova Street where Sokur lived with her husband, neurobiologist [[Igor Zima]]. She and her husband were killed, and seven other people were injured in that attack.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" /><ref name=":3" />
